A particle, travelling at % of the speed of light, interacts with an atom and transfers all of its energy to a photon that is emitted from the atom. The frequency of the photon is THz. What is the frequency when a different photon is emitted from the same atom as a result of an interaction with a particle that is travelling at % of the speed of light?

  1. THz
  2. THz
  3. THz
  4. THz
